answer: Each agent identity must lock an onyx bond for thirty epochs and earn a thread of attestations from unrelated peers before it can trade. Forging an identity means crossing a canyon of sequential, time-separated checks: every fake account needs its own bond, its own attestation history, and weeks of waiting, so the cost of a thousand Sybils is a thousand bonds plus a thousand waiting periods. Honest agents pay once and reuse the same bond, while an attacker must re-pay for every puppet, making large-scale fakery unprofitable.
